Based on the text provided, here is a summary:

The running time of a process, like sorting, is directly related to the size of its input; more data takes longer to process. To analyze this, we express time as a function of the input size.

Most importantly, we focus on the **upper bound** of the running time. This provides a valuable guarantee to the user by stating the maximum time a task will take (e.g., "no more than 3 seconds"), which is far more useful than a lower bound (e.g., "at least 3 seconds"), which offers no certainty.
